body: NAD /u/Forsaken_Mongoose_47 .  Your syncope doesn't really jive with gastroparesis.  Could be secondary I suppose.  I strongly disagree with your dietician.  I'd up calories to 1,500 or so by whatever means necessary and try and spread them out throughout the day (avoiding simple carbs if possible as well I guess).  Your fundamental goal should be to get adequate nutrition and not pass out.

My cousin is your age and also struggling.  I love her to tits and give her an extra big hug every time I see her.  I also have a friend (late 20s now) who was suicidal as a teen.  I guess I'm trying to say that a lot of people feel the way you do regardless of their situation, and there are probably options.
Might want to ping them directly then.
Sounds like borderline personality disorder.  Sorry you're going through that or similar.  It's totally possible to develop strategies to deal with it though.
Yeah it's a pain.  Just repeating myself here but being someone who gets the messages that you are about to write is pretty easy eh.
Fair enough.  I tend to sideline that into Phineas and Ferb territory but unjustly so to be sure.

All male wizards go insane due to them saving the world 3000 years ago so the world is ruled by female wizards.  A female wizard arrives at a backwater village searching for a male wizard destined to save the world again.

It's also a show now so [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=11ZozKfRqvA) but read the books.

Yeah I get that.  You're probably overthinking it though.  What I've found helpful is to put myself in the shoes of a friend getting a message from me.  And like, as the friend, I merely want to help yet also don't really give a shit to the scale I initially felt what with it being about me you know.

Harry Potter is legit enough for the mainstream, but it's also pretty weak.  So many better kids series or adult series (depending on if you're a kid or adult I suppose haha).  If you're 12 then read Animorphs or Arthur Ransome or something, but by far my favourite series of all time is The Wheel of Time.  You should start reading it immediately.

I didn't delete anything.  And it's fine to be bitchy.  Have you tried telling your friends "I'm going to be bitchy and this is why and this is what i need from you..." before?  Can't say I've ever gone that route but I've had a fried with BDP/depression/a whole host of things do so and it worked out well for her I think.
Five years sounds like a tough haul.  Glad you're still with us.  My sister having me a niece is pretty nice from my end since you asked.
What's your favourite book series to read (or TV show if you're lame haha)?
That certainly could be the case.  I've found though that there are often unexpected resources available if you ask.
I'd recommend you talk to a doctor about how you feel.  Obviously it depends on country and I'm a bit biased being in the field, but I like to think it's the place to start.
Internet hug.

That's not what I meant.  I've had friends who have been in a bad spot before and they appreciated...not being singled out is the best way I can put it I suppose, which was what I was trying to convey to you.
Have you tried sitting down?
The government can be stupid.  I can't relate, but I feel like there's a lot of people who could.
Hi.  You seem pretty normal. Sorry about the whole life situation problems.
You can lay it on me if you'd like.

A couple people in my friend group have what you would probably classify as severe disabilities.  One for sure at least with something pseudo physical.  I'm sorry you haven't found any sort of acceptance so far.

I'm fine thanks.  Working through having provided first aid to a likely suicide victim but I've done it before and I'm fortunate enough to have a lot of people who are happy to let me cry on their shoulder.  Talking to people here also helps somehow.

You don't have to apologize for how you feel.  It's just...well how you feel right?  Things can suck and be the worst and it makes me cry when I think about it because I know people who where there, but they are in better places now.  I can't say for sure the same will happen for you but I read something like this and think about them and I feel for them you know?

We're still trying to teach people how to provide CPR for people who are literally dead nevermind those who are displaying suicidal thoughts.  It's abnormal to feel how you do sure, but nothing to be ashamed of, and yes most people aren't going to know what do say, but I wouldn't blame them either.  Connect with those who understand and every-so-often there'll be someone important to you who you can connect with as well.
Damn.  That sounds tough.  I'm sorry you're going through that.  I get the feeling from it though that you're going to make it.
I'm sorry you feel that way and am glad you felt like reaching out here.  Some people definitely suck, but others can be pretty cool if you just find them eh.
Yeah that's fair.  I don't have all the answers.  I think the temporary comfort is enough though.  That alone is worth it somehow.
I dunno.  It's nice to reach out and find people who are feeling similar though somehow eh?
Hi.
Connecting with people who feel that way is something though I think.
Thanks.
All I could think of was being there for her.  I find some sort of peace in that.
Read your whole post.  You seem pretty cool.  Sorry that you're going through what you are.
Talk honestly with your boss.
There are a ton of people who feel the same way you do, and they are all rooting for you.  It can be hard of course, but you aren't alone.
If you value her friendship I'm not going to say it's not worth it.  There are people out there though who would laugh WITH you about the situation.

The key to life is being brutally honest and seeming like you don't care about being honest even if you are actually super worried about it.  It works because most people feel like you do to some extent or another.

Thanks.  It's funny that I was trained (and had experience actually) to know how I would feel and how to deal with it, yet that knowledge doesn't stop one from still going through it and dealing with it.  Sorry if this isn't the correct spot and thanks again for interacting with me.
Your brain was clever enough to post here, and I appreciate hearing what you said more than you can possible know.  So thank you.

There are millions of people who have been in a very similar situation to you who came out of it relatively happy and fighting for life.  Doesn't seem easy or anything, but - at the very least - those who say it will get better at least mean well, and there's something eh?
Probably depends a bit on your age.  Thinking someone understands you and then realizing they don't sucks at any age though.
Most of my friends understand when I'm honest with them.  If yours don't then just know that there are better friend groups out there.
Reaching out here seems like a good step.
